Messages.Author: Paul Schaaf
Messages.Body:
Does damage that gets prevented count for cards like Pulled Fangs and the
Stake? Example : Vamp A does 1 damage and vamp B does 2 damage. Vamp A
prevents 2 damage, so Vamp A takes 0 damage and vamp B takes 1. I guess
the real question is whether damage that gets prevented is actually dealt.

---------
Paul Schaaf
sch...@u.washington.edu

Messages.Author: CurtAdams
Messages.Body:
Paul Schaaf <sch...@u.washington.edu> writes:

>Does damage that gets prevented count for cards like Pulled Fangs and the

>Stake? Example : Vamp A does 1 damage and vamp B does 2 damage. Vamp A

>prevents 2 damage, so Vamp A takes 0 damage and vamp B takes 1. I guess
>the real question is whether damage that gets prevented is actually
dealt.

Since Damage Prevention prevents damage, rather than, say, allowing the
user to ignore it, I'd say that PF only counts what gets through.
Curt Adams (curt...@aol.com)

Messages.Body:
Paul Schaaf <sch...@u.washington.edu> writes:

>Does damage that gets prevented count for cards like Pulled Fangs and the

>prevents 2 damage, so Vamp A takes 0 damage and vamp B takes 1. I guess

No, it doesn't count if it is prevented (or Dodged, whatever)

L. Scott

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Pulled Fangs only tallies up the damage actually inflicted on the combatants.
Damage that was dodged, prevented, etc. is not considered.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
